title: Observability: Grafana VRRP failover (.184 app VIP cutover)
description: Runs `nexus failover-test cluster observability --direction grafana --yes`. Stops keepalived on the live VIP .184 master, polls the VIP onto the backup grafana node, measures the RTO, then restarts keepalived (nopreempt keeps the VIP put).

observe.what: VIP .184 moves grafana-master -> backup, RTO ~1-3s, recovery=recovered; 5-instant timeline table

whatProves: ObservabilityAdapter.FailoverAsync performs a keepalived VRRP cutover of the Grafana front-door VIP and measures the RTO; the grafana-db (.185) direction uses the identical code path.
